event.name: Intermediate Half-Court Challenge
event.description: Intermediate 5v5 basketball games at Canyon Sports Hub 2 in Gilbert. Registration details and facility reservation must be confirmed.

facility.name: Canyon Sports Hub 2
facility.description: Outdoor asphalt basketball courts in Gilbert suited to competitive games and small 3v3 tournaments. Booking requests require facility-manager approval.

messages.message: The proposed event format of 5v5 basketball is inconsistent with the facility description, which states that the venue is suited for competitive games and small 3v3 tournaments. Additionally, the event is scheduled to take place outdoors, which may not be ideal for an intermediate level event expecting 32 participants.
evidence: Event format is 5v5, while facility description mentions suitability for 3v3 tournaments.
The venue is outdoor, which may not support the expected number of participants effectively.
concerns: The facility may not accommodate a full 5v5 format due to its description focusing on smaller games.
Outdoor conditions could pose challenges for a larger event, especially in terms of participant comfort and safety.
